dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ahem, so what's the situation in need of mediation?

dialogues.speaker: Lakkaberry
dialogues.text: This person's been glaring daggers at me from behind since she arrived... Hey, you! I'm a member of the Fruity Order, you hear?

dialogues.speaker: "Ruthless Calla Lily"
dialogues.text: What a coincidence. So am I.

dialogues.speaker: Lakkaberry
dialogues.text: W—Wait, really?

dialogues.speaker: Lakkaberry
dialogues.text: I... first encountered the humor and intelligence of Trendy Zaytun Peach in the "New Tide Anthology." Then, I heard the legend of Intrepid Valberry while I was in the Fortress of Meropide.

dialogues.speaker: Lakkaberry
dialogues.text: The more I heard about your order, the more it drew me in. I've been searching for so long, but I was never able to find an actual member...

dialogues.speaker: Lakkaberry
dialogues.text: So when I heard that the Nod-Krai Trade Expo was being held again, I applied under your name... and now, I finally get to meet you!

dialogues.speaker: "Ruthless Calla Lily"
dialogues.text: Ugh... It's those idiots stirring up trouble again, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: So what I'm getting is that this guy's an impostor?

dialogues.speaker: "Ruthless Calla Lily"
dialogues.text: Our Order's won the expo rights several years in a row, so we announced that we were backing out of the running this year to avoid conflict. Then this guy had to come along...

dialogues.speaker: "Ruthless Calla Lily"
dialogues.text: A few of the other groups were looking to duke it out, so imagine their anger when someone claiming to be one of ours snatched the expo rights again...

dialogues.speaker: Lakkaberry
dialogues.text: Well, no one's made any trouble for me... Wait, does that mean you've taken them all out already? Man, I knew it! The Fruity Order's as good as they say!

dialogues.speaker: Lakkaberry
dialogues.text: Can I join?

dialogues.speaker: "Ruthless Calla Lily"
dialogues.text: We can't make trouble at the expo. Voynich Guild rules. Once it's all over, meet me at the harbor in Nasha Town.

dialogues.speaker: Lakkaberry
dialogues.text: I see... Alright, I'll be there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, does he not realize what's going on here?

dialogues.speaker: "Ruthless Calla Lily"
dialogues.text: Also, considering our smooth collaborations thus far, a word of advice for the Guild.

dialogues.speaker: "Ruthless Calla Lily"
dialogues.text: This guy has only been able to keep his head and his booth because the Fruity Order took care of any rival factions.

dialogues.speaker: "Ruthless Calla Lily"
dialogues.text: But if there's one thing the Treasure Hoarders have in spades, it's sore losers. Since our order has proven untouchable so far, they're sure to find easier targets to vent their frustration on.

dialogues.speaker: "Ruthless Calla Lily"
dialogues.text: So, look after those kids.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Huh. So this guy has been responsible for more than one conflict so far...
